452_html_well_formed.detail:
div.gmail_quote > attribution 'On , <
> wrote:
' > blockquote with style 'margin:0 0 0 .8ex;border-left:1px solid #ccc;padding-left:1ex' > message > : tags balance, the angle brackets around the address are escaped, and the CSS is valid. It matches Gmail's own shape closely enough to show as a quote (Gmail itself also sets class gmail_quote on the blockquote and wraps the attribution in div.gmail_attr; not needed to display). Gmail will show a recognised quote behind its trimmed-content toggle, which is normal.

c1_fast_reply_452.setup: FT row, PR (pr-AT-agency.example) replies on Zoya's thread 'any update on the slot?'. Zoya's FAST run answers in STEP 1 b.
c1_fast_reply_452.trace:
THREADING: draft action reply on the thread's latest message (the PR's), reply_all false, To PR, Cc Akshay. html_body: one

per paragraph, then the gmail_quote with the PR's message. The prompt doesn't say to read it with include_html, so the model either guesses the flag, uses its text (allowed fallback), or tries action original and has to decode MIME itself (MESSAGE IDENTITY tells it to keep only the Message-ID line). Plain-text body without a quote; MCP adds its own. Read-back: draft_read's html must hold the blockquote (unverified tool behaviour). PRE-SEND 1 to 6 unaffected. LEAK CHECK runs on the whole mail: if the PR's quoted message says 'great fit for the show', the literal word list bars 'fit' and the reply goes to Akshay's list unsent, or the model strips the quote and fails the read-back.
c1_fast_reply_452.result: works when the PR's mail has no barred word and draft_read returns html; else blocked. D2, D3, D4.

verdict.summary: Hashes, the bfbadf9 pin, the 75,799-character total, both version refs and a clean rebuild all check. The r14b to r15 diff holds only N1 to N7, 452 and 453 plus the forced pin, sha, total and version changes. Capture r12c is r12b plus the one 452 edit. N1, N2, N4, N5, N6 and N7 are fixed as written; N3 is half fixed (D9). The 452 quote is well formed. But it quotes whatever the thread's latest message is, team-only mail included (D1, high). Its read-back rests on draft_read behaviour nobody has tested (D2, the deploy gate). LEAK CHECK read literally bars quoted outside text (D3), and the prompt never says where the HTML comes from (D4). Capture's forwarded-pitch case quotes Saurabh's forward (D7). The 453 clause loses to 'no precall notes' (D10), clashes with 'rows waiting on Akshay are never yours' (D11), and has no show limit (D12, a question for Akshay).
